description: DB integration: changing tenant A from USD to AUD updates tenant A clients stored as USD, preserves tenant A clients stored as EUR, and leaves tenant B clients untouched against the migrated schema.
DB integration guard: an injected failure during the tenant settings write rolls back the preceding matching-client currency updates.
Action test: an unrelated partial billing-settings save and a same-currency save issue no client currency update, while permission failure issues no writes.
Action/UI test: a real currency change returns updated/preserved counts and DefaultCurrencySettings renders the propagation explanation and count-aware success message.

QuoteForm component test: a create form seeded with an AUD client shows AUD with client-source text; selecting a GBP client updates both; clearing the client restores the tenant default and tenant-source text.
QuoteForm component test: quick-adding a client applies that client's default currency and client-source text.
QuoteForm component test: applying a USD business template overrides an AUD client default and shows template-source text; a later picker change shows manual-source text.
QuoteForm component test: editing a saved quote and editing a saved business template retain their persisted currencies and saved-source labels despite current client/tenant defaults.
Quote action test: omitted currency resolves to client default, then tenant default, then USD, while explicit currency wins.
QuoteDetail component test: representative non-round minor-unit subtotal, discount, tax, and total values render at one-hundredth magnitude and use the quote currency.
